narr-title.speaker: narrator
narr-title.text: Meet Katarute. It teaches you until you say “got it” — and then checks back three days later.

narr-snap.speaker: narrator
narr-snap.text: Stuck on a problem? Just snap a photo. Katarute reads the topic and the question for you.

narr-learn.speaker: narrator
narr-learn.text: Then your AI senpai teaches you, right on the board. The math goes on the board. The voice just asks you questions.

narr-gotit.speaker: narrator
narr-gotit.text: The lesson only ends when you tap “Got it.” Then one review question is made from that board.

narr-later.speaker: narrator
narr-later.text: Three days later, your senpai checks back. Just one question — about thirty seconds.

narr-answer.speaker: narrator
narr-answer.text: Type your answer, and the AI grades it. Miss it, and it asks again after one, three, and seven days.

narr-keep.speaker: narrator
narr-keep.text: No scores. No rankings. Just the days you kept going, and the problems you solved.

narr-end.speaker: narrator
narr-end.text: Katarute. Taught until you say “got it.” Asked again in three days.

student-reply.speaker: student
student-reply.text: Um… x minus one, times x minus two?

senpai-opening.speaker: senpai
senpai-opening.text: Okay, let's take a look at this together.

senpai-step-0.speaker: senpai
senpai-step-0.text: Let's start from the inequality itself.

senpai-step-1.speaker: senpai
senpai-step-1.text: Factorise the left side for me. What do you get?

senpai-step-2.speaker: senpai
senpai-step-2.text: Right, so those two numbers are where it touches zero.

senpai-step-3.speaker: senpai
senpai-step-3.text: Now look at the curve. Where does it sit below the axis?

senpai-step-4.speaker: senpai
senpai-step-4.text: Between them. That is the whole answer.

senpai-step-5.speaker: senpai
senpai-step-5.text: The flow is: find the roots, then read where the graph is below zero.
